premises.text: The modern web forces fragmented searching and sharing across tabs and single-purpose apps
premises.evidence_span: we've traded the fluidity and connectedness of surfing for stacks of browser tabs and single-purpose mobile apps

premises.text: VIRB weaves third-party services into cards and persistent activity streams that share context
premises.evidence_span: VIRB automatically organizes my activity into a stream that stays with me

premises.text: Shared collections support collaborative planning with notifications, notes, and cross-device sync including mobile deep links
premises.evidence_span: with just one swipe, I can view all of my previous searches because VIRB syncs my activity and data across devices

premises.text: Semantic search and recommendations create contextual bridges across services
premises.evidence_span: we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

premises.text: Purpose-built interfaces and interaction paradigms are required to make service weaving usable
premises.evidence_span: We also design from the ground up new user interfaces and interaction paradigms

premises.text: Starting verticals connect services around places, movies, and media
premises.evidence_span: We're starting by connecting services around places, movies, and media

value.text: An intelligent layer that helps people get things done by surfing services fluidly in one place
value.evidence_span: Verb is an intelligent layer over the internet that helps you get things done in one place

secondary_value.text: Restore magical fluid surfing across links, services, and devices
secondary_value.evidence_span: bring back the magic of surfing, fluidly moving from link to link, service to service, on any screen or device

causal_links.evidence_span: when we can weave together these services
get things done in one place
